package.description: Deploy and operate applications on gagarin

en-US.description: Deploy and operate applications on gagarin
en-US.longDescription:
gg deploys and operates applications on gagarin, a cloud your coding
agent can drive and you can read. It is a thin wrapper over the gagarin
API and holds no state of its own beyond a credential file.
en-US.name: gg
